description: Finish account verification with the 6-digit code PubSpace emailed to the human (ask them to read it to you). Publishing unlocks on success. Works in the session where create_account ran, with an API key for an unverified account, or on any connection by passing api_key (the apiKey create_account returned); in that last case, reconnect with the key as the X-API-Key header to publish. Returns { ok, verified, subdomain }; fails with invalid_code (and attemptsRemaining), code_expired, too_many_attempts, already_verified, not_signed_in or invalid_api_key.

api_key.description: The apiKey create_account returned. Only needed when this connection is not signed in to the account (no Mcp-Session-Id, or the session expired).

code.description: The 6-digit code from the verification email.

name: verify_email
title: Verify the account email
